To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the polarization vector associated with the Balmer emission lines is different from that of the continuum; (2) the polarization of the emission lines is intrinsic; (3) the intrinsic polarization vector is constant across the Balmer lines, and points away from the continuum; (4) the intrinsic polarization is not due to scattering in a disk; (5) the intrinsic polarization can be explained by scattering in a spherical envelope with a density law n(r) ∝ r −2.5
we have discovered that the B[e] supergiant HD 45677 is a binary with a period of 3.8 days.
the polarization vectors of the emission lines of the B[e]-type star HD 4567 point away from the continuum in the same direction, at a mean intrinsic angle of 164 ± 3°.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new method for measuring the polarization of the light emitted by a star.
the study of the magnetic field and the circumstellar environment of B[e] stars.
the study of the magnetic fields in the atmospheres of cool stars and their relation to stellar activity and the evolution of stellar magnetic fields.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the B[e] phenomenon is a consequence of the interaction of the central object with its environment, which may be a circumstellar disk, a wind, or both.
the B[e] phenomenon is a complex phenomenon which can be explained as the result of a combination of different mechanisms.
the star is surrounded by a circumstellar disk with an inclination angle of about 40°.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the B[e] supergiant HD 45677 is a rapidly rotating star with a high mass-loss rate.
the ionized material around HD 45677 is a non-spherical disk.
the ionized gas is not only geometrically asymmetric but also magnetically asymmetric.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the polarization vectors associated with the Hα, Hα and Hγ emission lines are not aligned with the continuum polarization vector.
the ionized gas in the B[e] disk is not distributed in the same way as the dust.
the B[e] phenomenon in HD 45677 is caused by a disk of ionized material around the star.
